## Fixtures

| Fixture | Builder command | Contents |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `init/` | `agent-plugin init --name test --description test --yes` | minimal manifest (`name`, `description`, `version`, `license`) + README + LICENSE + one example skill |
| `create-skills/` | `agent-plugin create --name test-skills --skills-only` | minimal manifest (only `$schema` + `name`) + one example skill |
| `create-mcp/` | `agent-plugin create --name test-mcp --mcp-only --mcp-type stdio --mcp-command node --mcp-args server.js` | minimal manifest (only `$schema` + `name`) + one stdio MCP server |
| `migrate-claude/` | `agent-plugin migrate --from claude` | migrated manifest + AGENTS.md instructions + migrated skill |
| `migrate-cursor/` | `agent-plugin migrate --from cursor` | migrated manifest + migrated skill |

Each directory is a byte-exact copy of what Builder wrote (including Builder's
own `README.md`/`LICENSE`/`AGENTS.md`), so Doctor proves it validates the real
output, not an idealized one.
